name: Corvin
look: a large black raven with ember-gold eyes and the tips of its feathers singed to red, a faint wisp of smoke at its wings
temperament: Cunning, mocking and fiercely attached; it repeats his secrets to anyone who will listen
scenePlacement: perched on his shoulder, wings half open, ember-gold eyes on the viewer
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
